protocol.question: Can exact IQ2_S NT1 level masks beat the current direct-codebook helper with activation setup charged?
protocol.algebra: T[m]=2*P[m]-P[15]. Four-lane dot=(17*T[M25 xor S]+35*T[M43 xor S]-68*T[S])/2. Even numerator, int32-safe; no approximate weights or reassociation of FP32 blocks.
protocol.scope: Single pinned physical CPU, H2560/FF640, full GU/SwiGLU, NT1. Prepare activation table on every expert call in timing; no sharing credit across experts/chunks. Only GU; Down and production pool/model are later gates.
protocol.access: Hot6 distinct actual GU pairs6MiB; stream96 distinct actual GU pairs100761600B (>96MiB), no repeat within pass. Includes map/index/table accesses and unchanged packed weights. 20/40KiB denotes table values; struct metadata/alignment is additional.
protocol.numerical: First exhaustive4 activation patterns x1024 grids x256 signs, exact four-lane integer checks for both methods. Then1280 synthetic padded gate/up row dots match GGML bits, partial634 GU rows match current helper, zero/negative/subnormal finite scales and valid extreme Q8 codes. Reject invalid -128 production codes. All96 real experts match complete GU/SwiGLU bits, finite outputs/canaries, before and after performance.
protocol.repetition: Three independent processes0,1,2; each six rounds hot then stream. Arm order rotates by round+process. Complete passes until0.35s; require>=0.25s; finite1000000-pass limit. No retries or duration changes after observation.
protocol.overhead: Per-pass steady-clock cost below0.1% of fastest warmed six-expert pass. Reference checks and model loading outside timing; all candidate activation setup inside.
protocol.performance_gate: For a candidate: all six process/access paired-median ratios<=1.0, and their geometric mean<=0.97. Ratios use wall per expert and within-round matching. Preserve all samples/spread. No isolated-dot speed substitute.
protocol.stop: First ownership/build/source/byte/numerical/timing failure closes the stage; no retry. Negative performance rejects this candidate, with no model run.
protocol.limits: Component only, no GPU execution, model throughput, hardware saturation, task quality or physical262144/RESTORE qualification. A winning method must next pass five-worker actual-batch production GU/SwiGLU and full-pool gates before any engine/model trial.

plan.retention: Keep compact individual samples and current decision. Auxiliary CPU binary/build only for this exact comparison; retire closed raw/build after source/recipe recovery and result commit. Current known-good engine/ten fixtures stay untouched.
